symptom: ako/mxcli#2069: ARCH001 flagged the data view on ConversationalUI.ChatContext that hosts Conversational UI's chat snippet on every app page with a chat; the snippet takes that entity as its parameter, so no view entity or microflow can stand in.
cause: cross_module_data.star treated every cross-module entity on a widget as avoidable. #2034 exempted the System workflow entities by name; this is the general shape of the same false positive: the module's own UI asks for its own entity.
insight: Exempt by structure, not by module name: the page calls a snippet or links to a page of the entity's module whose parameter (refs kind 'parameter') is that entity. The refs table already carries both halves, so no new builtin was needed. Verified on a real catalog (TestApp + a ChatMod module) with the old rule as control: dvChat flagged before, not after; the bare data view stays flagged.
